title: UK Materials Passport (ukmp:MaterialPassport) v0.2
description: Validation schema for the credentialSubject of a UK Materials Passport. WP1 deliverable D1.2, project 10188380. v0.2 adds the WP3 baseline core extensions B1 (multi-level identity), B2 (passport succession / lifecycle), B3 (role-based field-level access tiers) and B4 (per-field applicability status), plus the optional recycledContent.feedstockSource. Strictly additive: every valid v0.1 passport remains valid. Draft for steering review.

subjectType.description: What the passport describes. 'ProductType' and 'Item' added in v0.2 (B1). Granularity is stated explicitly by identityLevel; when identityLevel is absent it is interpreted from subjectType (MaterialBatch ⇒ batch, ProductType ⇒ productType, Item ⇒ item; Product / Component ⇒ unspecified).

gs1:sgtin.description: B1 (v0.2). Serialised GTIN of an individual item, written '<GTIN>.<serial>' (same dotted convention as gs1:lgtin). The serial is 1–20 printable ASCII characters — a superset of the GS1 AI (21) character set 82; issuers SHOULD restrict serials to CSET 82. Satisfies the identifier requirement.

productTypeRef.description: B1 (v0.2). passportId of the product-type passport this batch or item instantiates. Type-level data is inherited by reference, not copied.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme. EN 18219:2026 permitted product-identifier schemes are recommended for EU DPP registry registrability; other schemes remain valid.

parties.description: B5 (v0.2). Parties other than the issuer (manufacturer, importer, authorised representative, distributor, …), each with its role.

recycledContentDetail.description: B9 (v0.2). Recycled-content claims scoped by material, component or layer (e.g. per-metal shares for batteries, per-layer for multilayer pipe). The aggregate recycledContent is unchanged and still required.

fieldStatus.description: B4 (v0.2). Per-field applicability status: for named fields, whether they are required, optional, conditional or not yet applicable, and on what legal or standards basis. Lets a passport state honestly that an obligation is pending (e.g. a methodology act not yet adopted) rather than leaving a silent gap.

identityLevel.description: B1 (v0.2). Granularity of the passport subject: a product type / model (one passport per type, e.g. construction products under Reg (EU) 2024/3110), a batch / lot, or a serialised individual item (e.g. batteries under Reg (EU) 2023/1542 Art 77). Optional; when absent it is interpreted from subjectType.

aggregation.description: B1 (v0.2). Physical containment links between passported subjects. parentRefs: passports of what this subject is contained in; childRefs: passports of what it contains (e.g. module serials in a pack; a pack in a stationary storage system). Material transformation (e.g. pack → black-mass lot) is NOT aggregation — it stays an EPCIS TransformationEvent.

lifecycle.description: B2 (v0.2). Lifecycle state and passport succession. A REVISION corrects or updates the same subject (append-only, same passportId; API /revisions). A SUCCESSOR is a new passport, with a new passportId, for a subject changed by a lifecycle transition (e.g. repurposing; API /successors), linked both ways via predecessorRefs / successorRefs. Absent ⇒ status 'original'.

predecessorRefs.description: Passport URI(s) this passport succeeds. Expected whenever status is not 'original'.

successorRefs.description: Passport URI(s) that succeed this one (added by revision when a successor is issued).

accessTier.description: B3 (v0.2). Cumulative access tiers: public ⊂ legitimate-interest ⊂ authority.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, evaluated against the credentialSubject (the passport object) in its JSON form as issued. A pointer to an object or array covers everything beneath it.

accessPolicy.description: B3 (v0.2). Role-based, field-level access tiers. Fields not covered by fieldTiers take defaultTier (default 'public'). Exchange APIs enforce tiers by OAuth2 scope and omit withheld fields, listing their pointers as withheldPaths.

fieldStatusEntry.description: B4 (v0.2). Applicability status of one field.

basis.description: Legal or standards basis, e.g. 'Reg (EU) 2023/1542 Art 7 — methodology act not adopted'.

reviewBy.description: Date by which the status should be re-assessed.

otherPartyId.description: Operator identifier beyond GLN — EN 18219:2026 recognises schemes including the GLEIF LEI; registry access under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778 ties to verified operator identity.

postalAddress.description: B5 (v0.2). Postal address of a party (schema.org PostalAddress shape).

contactPoint.description: B5 (v0.2). Electronic contact details of a party.

declaredUnit.description: B6 (v0.2). Declared or functional unit to which carbonFootprintPerDeclaredUnit and indicators refer, e.g. 1 kWh of total energy over service life (batteries), 1 m of pipe (construction), 1 kg.

lcaIndicator.description: B7 (v0.2). One impact-indicator result, optionally for one life-cycle stage or module. Values refer to lcaSummary.declaredUnit when present, otherwise to 1 kg.

indicator.description: Indicator code. EN 15804+A2 codes RECOMMENDED; PEF impact categories permitted.

lifecycleStage.description: EN 15804 module (A1-A3, A4, A5, B1-B7, C1-C4, D) or battery carbon-footprint stage (raw-material, production, distribution, end-of-life). Absent ⇒ total over assessmentBoundary.

recycledContentDetail.description: B9 (v0.2). A recycled-content claim scoped to one material, component or layer. Same fields and rules as recycledContentClaim, plus a mandatory scope.

material.description: Element symbol (e.g. 'Ni', 'Co', 'Li', 'Pb'), ISO 1043 polymer code, material name or CAS number.

componentRef.description: The component: a JSON Pointer into this passport (e.g. '/composition/substances/0') or the URI of the component's own passport.

layer.description: Layer of a multilayer product, e.g. 'outer', 'core', 'inner'.

feedstockSource.description: v0.2, optional, sector-neutral. Origin class of the recycled feedstock. Separates bottle, other packaging and textile feedstock (needed by the textiles profile and bottle-to-fibre claims); 'mixed' where more than one class contributes materially.

carbonFootprintPerDeclaredUnit.description: B6 (v0.2). Carbon footprint in kg CO2e per declaredUnit. Requires declaredUnit.

indicators.description: B7 (v0.2). Multi-indicator, per-module results. EN 15804 module D MUST be carried here, never in netAvoidedKgCo2ePerKg.

studyRefs.description: B8 (v0.2). LCA / carbon-footprint study, EPD or calculation-parameter documents.

verifierParty.description: B8 (v0.2). Independent verifier of the LCA study or EPD.
